name: Erik Magnusson
bio:
Erik's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by late nights tinkering with engines alongside his grandfather, a former rally mechanic. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at KTH Royal Institute of Technology, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he joined a small engineering firm that supplied components to several Formula teams, quickly rising through the ranks to become a project lead. His organizational skills and innovative problem-solving approach caught the attention of Anderson Racing, who recruited him to streamline their operational efficiency.

As Head of Operations, Erik is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the team's logistics, resource allocation, and performance analysis. He's known for his data-driven decision-making and ability to identify bottlenecks before they impact the team's performance. Erik believes in fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to contribute their best, and he's particularly skilled at translating complex technical information into actionable strategies for the entire team. Erik is an advocate for sustainable practices in motorsport, exploring new technologies and methodologies to minimize the team's environmental footprint.

physical.hairStyle: Short, slicked-back with a slight side part
physical.description: Erik is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out multi-tool, even to formal meetings.
Has a whiteboard in his office entirely dedicated to brainstorming sustainable motorsport solutions.
Insists on having fika (Swedish coffee break) at precisely 3 PM every day.
